security.item: An existing redirect for the same old address that the plugin did not create is never changed; only the plugin's own redirects are updated or unpublished.

fix.item: The warning about the System - Redirect plugin being off also appears when only "Archive articles moved into the category" is on.
The plugin log is rotated above 1 MB (one previous file kept).

addition.item: New option "301 redirect from the old address" (on by default): when an article enters the archive category and its URL changes, a 301 redirect from the old address is stored in the Joomla Redirects component. Administrators are warned if the System - Redirect plugin is off.
Descriptions for the Archive sources in the builder source picker.
Tested together with Essentials for YOOtheme Pro 3.0.15 and 4SEO 7.2.0 on Joomla 6.2.0 and 5.4.10.

fix.item: Manifest: added the licence element required by the develop branch of the JED Checker (rule PH3).

security.item: Automatic moves need a logged-in user with Edit State on the article; articles checked out by another user are skipped; guests and the command line never move articles.
Screen messages are generic; technical details are written only to the log. In the frontend they are shown only to users who can manage articles.
Search text and category titles of "Archive Information" are escaped.

addition.item: New option "Require create permission" (on by default) for the archive category.
If the archive category is deleted or trashed the automation pauses and administrators see a warning; if it is unpublished they are warned that moved articles are not public.
YOOtheme Pro version check: with YOOtheme Pro missing or older than 5.0 the builder integration stays off and administrators are warned.
YOOtheme Pro builder template type "Archived Articles" for the Joomla archive view, assignable by category (with child categories), page number and language.

Dynamic sources "Archived Articles", "Archived Article" and "Archive Information" (count, page, filtered month and year, search text, categories, filter form), with all article fields and custom fields.
Optional automation: archived articles are moved to a chosen category; a published article saved or batch-moved into that category is archived through the article model; "force archived" option.
